title: Visit Snow View Point in Nainital for stunning Himalayan views. Learn about timings, ropeway details, things to do, best time to visit, and nearby attractions.
content:
Snow View Point - Nainital,

 

Snow View Point is one of the most visited attractions in Nainital, located just a short distance from Naini Lake. As the name suggests, this viewpoint offers breathtaking views of the snow-clad Himalayan peaks like Nanda Devi, Trishul, and Nanda Kot on clear days.

What makes this spot extra special is the journey itself. You can either reach by road or enjoy the aerial ropeway ride, which is an attraction on its own. At the top, the cool breeze, the view of distant mountains, and the lake below create an unforgettable memory.

Families love this place because it’s not just about views - there are also binocular stations, a small amusement area for kids, and stalls selling snacks and souvenirs. For photographers, it’s a dream location, especially during sunrise or sunset when the mountains glow golden.

Best Time to Visit:

  • March - June (Peak Season): Pleasant weather (15°C–25°C), great for clear mountain views.
  • September - November (Moderate Season): Cool climate (10°C–20°C), with post-monsoon freshness and crystal-clear skies.
  • December - February (Low Season): Cold (0°C–10°C), often hazy, but still peaceful for those who love winter vibes.

Distance from City Center: 

Snow View Point is around 2.5 km from Mall Road, easily reachable by road or the Nainital Ropeway.

Timings & Entry Fee:

  • Timings: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (ropeway operational hours).
  • Entry Fee: Free (but ropeway charges apply).
  • Ropeway Fare: Approx. ₹300-₹500 per person (round trip).

Things to Do at Snow View Point :

  • Take a ropeway ride for scenic aerial views.
  • Enjoy panoramic sights of Nanda Devi, Trishul, and Nanda Kot peaks.
  • Capture stunning sunrise and sunset photographs.
  • Relax at viewing platforms with telescopes for close-up mountain views.
  • Spend time at the small amusement park for kids.
  • Taste local snacks and buy small souvenirs from the stalls.

Best 10 Places to Visit Near Snow View Point (within 50 km):

1- Naini Lake (2.5 km): Iconic boating and lakeside walks.

2- Naina Devi Temple (2 km): One of the 51 Shakti Peeths.

3- Tiffin Top (4 km): Picnic spot with sweeping views.

4- Eco Cave Gardens (3 km): Family-friendly caves and musical fountain.

5- Naina Peak (6 km): Highest point in Nainital.

6- Hanuman Garhi Temple (4 km): Best for sunset views.

7- Khurpatal Lake (12 km): Quiet lake away from the crowd.

8- Bhimtal Lake (22 km): Larger, peaceful lake with island temple.

9- Sattal (27 km): Seven serene lakes in pine forests.

10- Ghorakhal Temple (20 km): Famous wish-fulfilling temple with bells.
excerpt: Snow View Point is the perfect mix of natural beauty and family fun in Nainital. With ropeway rides, Himalayan views, and nearby attractions, it’s a must-visit for anyone traveling to the Lake District of India.
